clue.text: I'm not sure about conservationists before one comes in

indicators.note: about means the hesitation sound goes around the next pieces

parts.note: er is the noise of someone unsure
NT is the National Trust, the British conservation charity
ere is an old word for before

explanation.surface: Someone hesitates over environmentalists just before a person walks in.
explanation.walkthrough: The National Trust (NT) is a British charity that looks after historic houses and countryside.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who goes into a place is, by simple word formation, its entrant.

clue.text: Writer glad aeroplane crashed

indicators.note: crashed means the letters are smashed into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An author is pleased that a plane came down.
explanation.definitionFit: The American author of macabre tales and poems such as The Raven.

clue.text: Criminals which I am holding, including the First Lady

indicators.note: including means the first woman goes inside

parts.note: this is the thing I hold in my hand
Eve is the first woman in the Bible

explanation.surface: A list of crooks held in hand that includes the president's wife.
explanation.definitionFit: People who steal are a common class of lawbreaker.

clue.text: No-good singer messed up

indicators.note: messed means the remaining letters are jumbled
no-good says the letter for good is removed

explanation.surface: A useless vocalist made a mess of things.
explanation.walkthrough: 'No-good' removes G (good) from singer, leaving SINER, which 'messed' rearranges.
explanation.definitionFit: Having got out of bed or come back from the dead, one has risen and is up.

clue.text: 1 down's 5 down Ted heard is horrible

indicators.note: horrible suggests the letters are made hideous, scrambled

explanation.surface: Someone named Ted overheard something dreadful.
explanation.definitionFit: Poe's The Masque of the Red Death names the plague that intrudes on a masked ball.

clue.text: Philosophical stance that 24 hours is a month

parts.note: a day, here Monday, shortened to Mon
M is the standard abbreviation for month

explanation.surface: A philosopher's position that a day counts as a whole month.
explanation.definitionFit: The doctrine that reality is ultimately one single substance is a classic philosophical position.

clue.text: What's central to surrealism as questionable court entertainment in Tudor times

indicators.note: what is central lies within the words, so the letters sit inside them

explanation.surface: A puzzle about surrealist elements in dubious Tudor court shows.
explanation.definitionFit: A masked dramatic entertainment with music and dancing, popular at the Tudor and Stuart courts.

clue.text: Navy constantly increasing, as 1 down's 11 said

parts.note: ever means always, constantly
more means increasing in amount

explanation.surface: A navy keeps on expanding, as Poe's bird might have put it.
explanation.definitionFit: The bird in Poe's poem The Raven croaks this single word as its refrain.

clue.text: America turned over apparently frozen papers in self-destructive act

indicators.note: turned over means the two letters are flipped

parts.note: US is America

indicators.note: in means the papers go inside the frozen water

parts.note: ice looks frozen, being frozen water
ID means identity papers

explanation.surface: America's frozen documents are overturned in a self-defeating move.
explanation.definitionFit: Killing oneself is the ultimate self-destructive act; also used figuratively.

clue.text: Missing Ireland, young female has the blues, missing parts even of easy ballet moves

indicators.note: missing tells us the country's abbreviation drops out of the word for a lass

parts.note: a girl is a young female
someone who has the blues is sad, so 'is sad'

indicators.note: dropping the even-numbered letters of easy leaves its odd ones

explanation.surface: A melancholy girl, without Ireland, struggles with simple dance steps.
explanation.walkthrough: GIRL loses IR to give GL; 'missing parts even of' strips the 2nd and 4th letters of 'easy', leaving ES.
explanation.definitionFit: In ballet, a gliding step from one position to another is named for sliding, as on snow.

clue.text: Imposing taxes without the French competing

indicators.note: without tells us the French article is removed

parts.note: levying means imposing taxes
le is the French for the

explanation.surface: A government taxes people without the French joining the contest.
explanation.definitionFit: Contending with rivals for a prize is a plain synonym for striving against them.

clue.text: Girls' nose-pegs revolt people like Mahalia Jackson and Al Green

definitions.text: people like Mahalia Jackson and Al Green

indicators.note: revolt means the letters rise up and overturn their order

explanation.surface: Girls rebel against wearing nose clips.
explanation.definitionFit: Both are famous performers of Christian devotional music in the African-American tradition.

clue.text: New party starts to hunt aggressively

parts.note: a rave is a big dance party

indicators.note: starts to signals the opening letter of the word new is used

explanation.surface: A fresh party begins to chase its prey hard.
explanation.walkthrough: The Raven is Poe's famous poem, which ties to the theme.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, this old word means to seek or devour prey greedily, like a predator.

clue.text: Earl has doubts about king's attendants

indicators.note: about means the doubts wrap around the royal letter

parts.note: queries are doubts or questions
R is short for rex, king; the 's reads as 'king is' or a link

explanation.surface: A nobleman is uncertain about the monarch's servants.
explanation.definitionFit: These are officers of the British royal household who personally attend a sovereign.

clue.text: Hear "hotel" is tent outside walls

indicators.note: walls means the outer words enclose the letters we want, as walls enclose a room

explanation.surface: A guest is told the hotel is really just a tent beyond the walls.
explanation.definitionFit: To hear someone out is to pay attention to them, the two-word phrasal verb.

clue.text: Outgoing message to dog with start at the bottom

indicators.note: start at the bottom says the opening letter moves to the end in this down entry

parts.note: a text is a phone message
Rover is a stock name for a dog

explanation.surface: A text sent to a dog, with its beginning moved to the end.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to' is only a link word; 'with start at the bottom' moves the T of TEXTROVER to the end.
explanation.definitionFit: A sociable, outgoing person is the opposite of an introvert.

clue.text: Deadly gas in our vicinity — stick together!

parts.note: CO is carbon monoxide, a poisonous gas
here means near us

explanation.surface: A warning that poisonous fumes are nearby, so everyone should stay close.
explanation.definitionFit: Parts that stick together form a united whole, the sense of the verb.

clue.text: Swallowed by fish — total nightmare

indicators.note: swallowed by means the word for total goes inside the fish

parts.note: bream is a fish
add means total, sum up

explanation.surface: Being eaten by a fish would be a complete horror.
explanation.definitionFit: A frightening vision during sleep is a nightmare.

clue.text: Areas of responsibility when restricting amount transmitted

indicators.note: restricting means the word for when holds the data unit inside

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as I left'
Mbit, a megabit, is an amount of data sent

explanation.surface: Limits on how much may be broadcast define each department's scope.
explanation.definitionFit: Spheres of influence or scope over which someone has authority are their remits.

clue.text: Identifying lines when hearing dog recite poetry?

indicators.note: when hearing means the words are judged by their sound

parts.note: a dog's poem would be a bark ode

explanation.surface: A whimsical picture of a dog declaiming verse.
explanation.definitionFit: The striped lines printed on products identify them when scanned.

clue.text: Launches imitations

definitions.meaning: departures of aircraft into the air

explanation.surface: Rocket launches and mimicry.
explanation.definitionFit: The noun means both an aircraft's lift into the air and a parody of a person.

clue.text: Weary lot devours half a reptile

indicators.note: devours means the fate word swallows the piece

parts.note: one's lot is one's fate

indicators.note: half a means only the first half of the lizard is used

parts.note: an iguana is a reptile

explanation.surface: A tired group eats part of a lizard.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb, to tire someone out or exhaust them.

clue.text: A number more angry about someone noisy in bed

indicators.note: about means the angrier word goes around the number letter

parts.note: sorer means more annoyed
N stands for a number in maths

explanation.surface: Getting angrier about a number of sleepless nights beside a noisy partner.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who snores keeps others awake by making noise while asleep.

clue.text: Took finely mashed cut of meat for energy

indicators.note: for means the cut of meat replaces the energy letter

parts.note: puréed food is finely mashed
E is the symbol for energy
loin is a cut of meat

explanation.surface: A cook took smooth mashed food and swapped in a joint for energy.
explanation.walkthrough: The Purloined Letter is a Poe story, part of the theme.
explanation.definitionFit: To steal is to take something; this word is a formal term for stealing.

clue.text: To get on with colleagues, meet at home

parts.note: meet as an adjective means fit or suitable
in means at home

explanation.surface: Advice that to get along at work, you should meet colleagues at home.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who is accepted socially by a group is said to belong with it, a phrasal verb.

clue.text: White grains, usually 50 in number

indicators.note: in means the numeral sits inside the number

parts.note: four is a number
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Fifty white grains in a number, as a count.
explanation.definitionFit: Ground wheat for baking is usually white and powdery.

clue.text: Express feelings as far right leaves

indicators.note: leaves means the abbreviation for right departs from the word

parts.note: remote means far away

explanation.surface: Someone shows emotion as the political far right walks out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'far right' reads as politics, but 'far' and 'right' work separately.
explanation.definitionFit: To display emotions theatrically is what an actor does when acting out feelings.

clue.text: Regret finding gourmet mostly mutilated in scene of 1 down's 27

parts.note: rue means regret

indicators.note: mutilated means the remaining letters are mangled into a new order
mostly means the word loses its last letter

explanation.surface: Sorrow at finding a food lover hacked about, at the scene of a crime.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mostly' drops the T of gourmet; 'mutilated' rearranges GOURME. The Murders in the Rue Morgue is Poe's detective story set in a Paris street.
explanation.definitionFit: Poe's killings take place in a Paris street, so the street is their setting.

clue.text: Landlord, 22 from 1 down

definitions.meaning: the stolen item in Poe's story, completing the title with entry 22

explanation.surface: A landlord and a Poe title fragment.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who lets property is one sense; the other completes Poe's story title The Purloined ___.

clue.text: Kills returning sister with electronic instrument

indicators.note: returning means the whole string is read backwards

parts.note: a drum is a percussion instrument

explanation.surface: A nun comes back with an electronic instrument and slays people.
explanation.definitionFit: The verb meaning to slay unlawfully is a direct synonym for kills.
